label: Совершенно
description: A 10-sentence usage card for совершенно (completely, absolutely).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Total degree with a verb. 'Совершенно' means completely or utterly, intensifying 'забыл' to an absolute extent. It stands before the verb and pushes the meaning to a full hundred percent.
Strategic focus: Absolute agreement. 'Совершенно' intensifies the short adjective 'прав' to mean absolutely right. This is a common, emphatic way to express full agreement.
Strategic focus: Total contrast. 'Совершенно' modifies 'другая', stressing that the story is entirely different. The adverb sits before the adjective and marks a complete, not partial, difference.
Strategic focus: Full degree of a state. 'Совершенно' grades the short adjective 'спокойна' to mean perfectly calm. It precedes the predicate and conveys an absolute, settled condition.
Strategic focus: Emphatic concord. 'Совершенно' intensifies 'согласен' to mean completely in agreement. The adverb stands before the predicate adjective and strengthens the assent fully.
Strategic focus: Absolute state in the past. 'Совершенно' modifies the predicate adverb 'тихо' to mean utterly silent. Placed before the word it scales, it marks total, complete quiet.
Strategic focus: Total negation. 'Совершенно' before 'не понимает' strengthens the negative to mean does not understand at all. It is a strong, common way to intensify a denial.
Strategic focus: Complete newness. 'Совершенно' modifies 'новый', stressing the phone is brand new. The adverb stands before the adjective and pushes the quality to its fullest.
Strategic focus: Total indifference. 'Совершенно' intensifies the idiom 'всё равно' to mean utterly indifferent. It heightens the phrase to an absolute, emphatic don't care at all.
Strategic focus: Full degree with instrumental. 'Совершенно' grades 'простой' to mean entirely simple. Standing before the adjective, it presents the simplicity as complete and total.
